findings.summary: The new test reminder sends the next due person's name and phone number through the external notification provider, which contradicts the requirement that external reminders contain only a link without contact details.
findings.evidence: sendTest effects: "The test shows the next due person's name and phone number so the owner sees a realistic example" vs S.webapp.prompts: "Optional external reminders, when enabled, must be limited to one owner notification per local day containing a link without contact details" and NotificationJob invariant "One owner notification per local day containing a link without contact details"

findings.summary: The hook fixture now checks test-reminder delivery, but the criterion it evidences says nothing about test reminders, so the hook tests something the criterion does not claim and the reminder content rule stays unchecked.
findings.evidence: hook fixture: "six due goals yield five ordered cards; an owner test reminder is delivered once" vs C.webapp.prompts.bounded claim: "Six due goals yield exactly five ordered cards. Duplicate jobs must not duplicate prompts or owner reminders"
